verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists a "Conversational meeting assistant" and "search across calls", which suggests natural-language querying of meetings, but there is no detail on how it works. Its official MCP server lets external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT reach meeting data, but there the answering is done by the third-party assistant, so it is only adjacent support. missing for 10: documentation that questions span the whole meeting history, documentation that answers cite sources or link back to meetings, any detail on the assistant's capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
